newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE nearby wheat trades lower in light volume.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE nearby wheat trades lower in light volume.

text.p: Nearby active Sydney wheat futures traded lower in light volumes on Tuesday.
Traders said wheat found little support in the main trading session, leaving January and March to each fall by A$2.00 to A$156,00 and A$158.00 a tonne respectively.
Recent upwardly revised forecasts for the 1996/97 Australian wheat crop have injected a fresh bearish tone into the market.

The Australian Wheat Board now sees the crop at 20 million tonnes, up from a previous forecast of 19 million. Australia Wheat Forecasters Pty Ltd has lifted its forecast to 20.43 tonnes from 19.80 million.
This has been only partly countered by the Australian Wheat Board's decision on Monday to leave unchanged its 1996/97 pool estimate for Australian Standard White (ASW) at A$195.00/tonne.
